title: Testing Function Calling Systems
query: Which testing approach is most appropriate for validating that an LLM correctly selects between 50+ available functions?

options.text: Unit tests that mock the LLM and test each function individually
End-to-end tests with real LLM calls covering common user scenarios
Golden dataset evaluation with representative queries and expected function calls
Manual testing by QA team for every possible function combination

explanation: Testing LLM function calling requires a GOLDEN DATASET approach: (1) Collect representative real-world queries, (2) Define expected function calls for each, (3) Run the LLM against the dataset, (4) Compare actual vs expected, (5) Track regression. Unit tests (A) can't test selection logic since it's in the LLM. E2E tests (B) are valuable but don't provide comprehensive coverage. Manual testing (D) doesn't scale. Golden datasets allow: automated regression testing, coverage tracking, performance benchmarking, and A/B testing of prompt changes.
learning_points: LLM systems need different testing strategies than traditional software
Golden datasets = representative queries + expected outputs
Track metrics: accuracy, precision, recall for function selection
Test prompt changes against baseline with golden dataset
Combine: golden dataset (primary) + E2E (critical paths) + integration tests
Monitor production: log actual calls vs expected for continuous improvement

why_golden_dataset: Provides deterministic baseline for regression testing
Allows A/B testing of prompt engineering changes
Scales to hundreds of test cases efficiently
complementary_approaches: Unit tests: for parameter validation logic
Integration tests: for function execution pipeline
E2E tests: for critical user journeys
Canary testing: gradual rollout with monitoring
Shadow testing: run new version alongside production
what_to_measure: Selection accuracy: % of queries where correct function was chosen
Parameter accuracy: % where all parameters extracted correctly
Latency: p50, p95, p99 response times
Cost per query: token usage and API costs
Failure modes: what types of queries fail most often

production_considerations: Store production queries that failed for dataset expansion
Use semantic similarity to avoid duplicate test cases
Include edge cases: ambiguous queries, missing info, invalid requests
Test across different LLM temperatures and models
Version your golden dataset with your code
